description: This file contains tests for the Playwright testing framework, specifically testing the functionality of repeating tests via command line and configuration settings. It imports testing utilities, executes inline tests, and verifies the repeat behavior through assertions.

methods.name: test('should repeat from command line')
methods.description: A test case that runs inline tests with a repeat count specified via command line argument and verifies the output and behavior.

methods.name: test('should repeat based on config')
methods.description: A test case that runs inline tests with a configuration defining multiple projects with different repeat settings and verifies the correct execution and project assignment.
